profile.name: GarryLee
profile.eyebrow: 能源动力 · 等离子体物理
profile.headline: 在等离子体物理中，理解能量、流动与结构。
profile.headlineEn: Understanding energy, flow, and structure through plasma physics.
profile.introduction: 中国科学技术大学能源动力专业研究生，研究兴趣集中于等离子体物理及相关科学计算。我希望以清晰、可复核的方式理解问题，并将研究过程沉淀为可靠的方法与工具。
profile.introductionEn: I am a graduate student in Energy Engineering at the University of Science and Technology of China. My interests center on plasma physics and related scientific computing, with an emphasis on clear, reproducible methods and useful research tools.

focus: 科研计算与数据可视化
focusDetails: 关注等离子体中的输运、结构及相关物理机制。
从能源动力视角理解复杂系统中的能量传递与演化。
使用代码完成数据处理、计算结果表达与科研图形制作。
探索 Codex 与多 Agent 在资料整理、编程和研究辅助中的可靠用法。
focusDetailsEn: Interested in transport, structures, and the physical mechanisms of plasma systems.
Studying energy transfer and evolution in complex systems from an energy engineering perspective.
Using code for data processing, computational communication, and scientific visualization.
Exploring reliable uses of Codex and multi-agent systems in research, coding, and knowledge work.
